games.name: The Battle Bricks
games.desc:
[UPDATE - CHAPTER 5]: Undead Cation, a brand new challenging chapter along with overhauls and quality of life changes for the majority of the game.

The Battle Bricks is a single-player tower defense styled game where you send units to defeat enemy bases to progress through stages! Although, the enemies will send units to attack back!
